purpose: Separate healthy-run useful-work coverage, normal completion-relative continuation latency, and abrupt-loss replacement latency. Commercial-agent competitiveness requires all three to be evidenced.

normal_rolling_continuation_gap.definition: first meaningful next-invocation progress minus predecessor normal-close reference after verified close+offset rearm
normal_rolling_continuation_gap.note: Do not equate configured +60s DTSTART offset with actual delivery latency; measure each wake.

abrupt_loss_recovery_gap.definition: first meaningful replacement-worker progress minus last meaningful predecessor progress after unexpected disappearance

current_capability.healthy_run: PROMISING_NOT_ACCEPTED; historical 01:00 window had 852s endpoint coverage but strict substantive gap audit found 125s max vs 120 allowed
current_capability.same_canonical_normal_rolling_reentry: PRODUCTION_OBSERVED; durable 03:32 due produced same-canonical invocation near 03:33:04, approximately 64s scheduler delay

actions_schedule_limit: GitHub officially documents a minimum 5-minute schedule interval and warns scheduled workflows can be delayed under load and may even be dropped. Therefore Actions cron is a liveness rescue layer, not a <=120-second fast-recovery mechanism.
interpretation: Rolling same-canonical rearm now has production evidence for normal fast continuation, removing fixed-quarter normal-gap loss. It does not solve abrupt invocation loss: if a turn disappears after provisional arming, rescue may still be roughly 13 minutes plus jitter. Keep normal continuation and abrupt-loss recovery as separate metrics.
promotion_rule: Do not call RRuleR SaaS-grade on utilization or normal rolling continuation alone. Require three accepted coverage windows plus abrupt-loss recovery demonstrated under an independent wake path without duplicate substantive execution.
next_experiment: Continue rolling utilization acceptance sampling. Separately, after an independent Work event consumer is provisioned and write probe passes, simulate a stale owner in the event lab and measure abrupt-loss recovery <=120 seconds.
